name: Claude badge
author: Brett
description: Tests the AI connection every time the console loads and attaches a Claude badge to the banner (framework badge asset, top left). Connected: green, and a tooltip pops out to its right for 5 seconds saying “Powered by” and the model (e.g. Claude Opus 5.5). Account works but out of credits: amber, “Out of credits”. Can't connect (bad token or invalid account): grey, “AI unavailable”. The icon for each of the three states is picked in its settings. Uses the AI assistant's model service (axf.llm@1). Removing the plugin removes only the Claude badge; the banner, badge and clock asset types stay in the framework. When connected, the tooltip also names the active Claude account's email (from AI keys, when installed). A second badge watches the Claude Code login on the VPS with plain code, no tokens: green logged in, amber limit hit, red not logged in, grey when the VPS can't be read. Each badge can be hidden, set to Icons only and given its own icon per state.
